translations.web: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
translations.bsb: After shrieking and convulsing him violently, the spirit came out. The boy became like a corpse, so that many said, “He is dead.”
translations.kjv: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
translations.asv: And having cried out, and torn him much, he came out: and the boy became as one dead; insomuch that the more part said, He is dead.
